authority.alpha_prerequisite: Continue D-01 by replacing inconsistent scalar deployment and implicit path/configuration behavior with one canonical installed-estate tree and one generated typed contract that the CLI, server, UI and SDKs consume. This package supplies bounded D-01 and POAM-022 evidence only; it cannot close D-01, D-02, F-01, any J gate, POAM-006/020/022, the alpha objective, or promotion.

current_behavior: At clean baseline f2f69916, the walking product can plan/apply/open/serve/ready/verify, but its public API exposes one DeploymentMode enum that conflates storage, process topology and listener presentation. Installation invents an organization segment, includes an absolute project_root in the durable plan and locator, creates parent directories implicitly, and identifies configuration only by an opaque digest derived from the profile. RrdEngine infers embedded versus rrflowMX from storage-root presence while the server independently infers local-daemon versus remote from TLS. Request QueryBudget and context limits are validated only against compile-time maxima, not an installed operator ceiling. The repository also contains legacy .rrflow/instance.toml plus an old direct .rrflow/rrd root, so silently installing the new roots/<instance> layout here would create two authorities.
target_behavior: Establish one canonical project-local estate contract and rollout boundary. A new transport-neutral module owns InstalledEstateIdentity, independent deployment_form/storage_profile/endpoint_presentation axes, and a revisioned self-digesting EstateConfiguration containing reasoning, recall and query ceilings. Install planning accepts the bundled default or an explicit bounded TOML input, seals the complete effective configuration into the deterministic plan, previews every parent directory/file in exact order, and carries no absolute host path. Apply consumes only those sealed bytes, creates owner-only directories and secret files, persists the same identity/configuration with the installed record, then publishes a minimal portable locator. Installed open verifies and binds the values into RrdEngine. Query and context work above the installed ceiling fails before reads or mutations. Server capabilities project the same values, derive endpoint presentation from the actual bound address, report the missing reasoning executor honestly, and regenerate OpenAPI/SDK discovery. Existing legacy .rrflow state is rejected, not migrated or allowed to coexist; its direct convergence is a following package.
unchanged_behavior: README identity, version 1.0.0, pre-release maturity, roadmap and POA&M owners remain unchanged; no gate or deficiency closes.

RrdEngine remains the only durable-effect authority. Configuration governs effects and resource ceilings, not exploratory reading, hypothesis formation, private model reasoning or a schema of thought.

rrflowKV remains the durable profile, rrflowMX remains volatile, and Arrow/DataFusion remain in-process compute. No subprocess, model provider, external database, sibling checkout, network fetch or Connectome runtime becomes a default prerequisite.
Connectome remains a separate optional client/integration and must consume generated capabilities; this package does not edit its repository or create Connectome-owned RRFlow state.
Hard compiled safety maxima remain absolute. Durable estate configuration may only lower them, and a request may only choose a value at or below the durable ceiling.
Attunement may discover and later recommend configuration, but it cannot activate a recommendation in this package. A later digest-bound configure plan/apply operation is required.

No current legacy .rrflow path is deleted, moved or rewritten. New-install collision detection preserves user state and blocks parallel authority until a separately planned convergence/migration package.
Release acquisition, signatures, SBOM, offline bundle assembly, shell/platform installers, uninstall, repair, full attunement execution and clean-machine qualification remain J/D follow-on work.
No storage format, WAL durability policy, benchmark threshold, promotion result, endpoint operation identity, authentication rule or authorization boundary is weakened.

research.reason: The user explicitly requested deep research and this package sets long-lived identity, configuration, process and observability boundaries. The implementation uses primary specifications and official project documentation, mapped to existing RRFlow code rather than copied as a foreign architecture.

sources.title: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme
sources.retained_behavior: Configuration and plan digests require deterministic, domain-separated serialization over typed values; cross-language canonical JSON is a future outward-signing option.
sources.rejected_assumption: Ordinary object JSON text is automatically stable across languages or map orderings.

sources.title: Apache Arrow columnar format introduction
sources.retained_behavior: Use Arrow as the standardized in-memory/IPC representation at an explicitly measured boundary.
sources.rejected_assumption: Arrow owns RRFlow configuration, identity or durable lifecycle.

sources.title: Apache Arrow columnar format
sources.retained_behavior: Keep hot analytical data columnar and bounded; choose layouts for measured access patterns.
sources.rejected_assumption: Every reasoning or recall object should be forced into one columnar schema.

sources.title: Apache Arrow security
sources.retained_behavior: Treat Arrow IPC input as untrusted and keep allocation/resource validation at the RRFlow boundary.
sources.rejected_assumption: A standardized memory format supplies authorization or safe allocation by itself.

sources.title: Apache DataFusion configuration
sources.retained_behavior: Translate engine-owned policy into explicit DataFusion session/runtime options when the streamed provider lands.
sources.rejected_assumption: DataFusion environment variables should become RRFlow's durable source of truth.

sources.title: DataFusion execution module
sources.retained_behavior: Preserve distinct runtime, session and task state with bounded memory/disk resources.
sources.rejected_assumption: A dedicated subprocess is inherently faster or is required for DataFusion correctness.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry signals
sources.retained_behavior: Use traces for bounded operation paths and metrics for aggregate resource behavior.
sources.rejected_assumption: Private reasoning text or arbitrary project content should be logged as telemetry.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Trace API
sources.retained_behavior: Correlate install/config/query stages with stable identifiers and bounded attributes.
sources.rejected_assumption: Creating spans establishes lifecycle authority or evidence correctness.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification
sources.retained_behavior: Project the canonical contract for UI and SDK discovery rather than hand-maintaining consumer schemas.
sources.rejected_assumption: OpenAPI availability proves an operation is authorized, configured or production-qualified.

sources.title: Rust OpenOptions create_new
sources.retained_behavior: Use atomic create-new semantics for collision-sensitive files; dangling symlinks fail.
sources.rejected_assumption: An exists check followed by create is a safe publication primitive.

sources.title: Kubernetes configuration best practices
sources.retained_behavior: Separate versioned declarative configuration from code and credentials and make precedence explicit.
sources.rejected_assumption: Discovery or a default silently authorizes activation.

sources.title: The Update Framework specification
sources.retained_behavior: Keep release acquisition/signature/rollback trust separate from project-local installation and configuration.
sources.rejected_assumption: A local executable digest is equivalent to signed release provenance.

stop_conditions: Any implementation edit exists before the planning-only commit or the validator cannot bind the exact clean baseline and changed paths.
The canonical identity requires a fabricated organization, absolute host root, Connectome-owned state, provider identity or a second lifecycle/configuration authority.
Planning writes, activates an adapter, reads credentials, executes project code, fetches a resource or accepts an unbounded/symlinked configuration input.

Apply rereads mutable configuration instead of the sealed plan, silently migrates legacy state, coexists with .rrflow/instance.toml or the old direct .rrflow/rrd root, or publishes before durable readback.
A configured ceiling can exceed a compiled safety maximum, be bypassed by query/live-query/index/context paths, or silently change through attunement.
Reasoning limits would require modeling private thought or falsely claiming a reasoning executor exists; retain the typed ceiling as unavailable future capability instead.
Arrow/DataFusion would become identity/configuration authority, an undeclared subprocess, a mandatory external service or a claimed zero-copy boundary without measurement.
SDK/UI discovery requires a hand-maintained schema that differs from rrd-contract/OpenAPI or retains DeploymentMode compatibility.
Tests require credential disclosure, weakened authentication/durability, changed storage bytes, a benchmark threshold change, a version bump, gate closure or official-origin activity.
Scope expands into legacy migration/deletion, configure apply, full attunement, install bundle/signing, repair/uninstall, cross-platform ACL qualification or Connectome implementation.
roadmap_status_change: None. This package provides partial D-01 and POAM-022 evidence by establishing a canonical install layout/configuration/deployment contract and enforcing currently available query/context ceilings. D-01, D-02, F-01, H-04, J-01 through J-05, POAM-006/020/022, alpha outcomes, release qualification, strict storage promotion and official promotion remain open. Legacy layout convergence, durable configure plan/apply, reasoning execution, streamed DataFusion and clean-machine distribution are explicitly following packages.
